basic_info.description: Welcome to this gorgeous home nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac and best block at the edge of Oceanview & Ingleside. The landscaped front with a sleek array of succulents gives the home a modern appeal that sets it apart in the neighborhood.  The elegant fluted wood panels, tiled floors, and lighting at the entry foyer set the tone for the rest of the home. Bathed in natural light, the spacious living areas offer serene views of the cityscape thru large windows. The gas fireplace creates a cozy ambiance when entertaining.  The classic kitchen is beautiful and equipped with modern appliances. The stylishly remodeled bathroom illuminated by a skylight, makes an immediate impression. Both blend modern design with timeless appeal.  The lower level features a bonus 1bd, 1bath space,perfect for guests, extended family, or even rental income. This versatile suite offers additional living flexibility while maintaining privacy from the main house.  The landscaped, low-maintenance backyard is the perfect spot to entertain, grill, or dine alfresco. At the top of the yard, you’ll find a tranquil retreat planted with olive trees & a pink lemon tree, ideal for reading, relaxation, and soaking in views of the Bay.   Only minutes to Whole Foods, hotspots on Ocean Ave, Hwy 280 & Balboa BART Statn.
